name: React Native
desc: Native iOS and Android from React components. Use when a web React team must also ship mobile.

name: Flutter
desc: One rendering engine drawing identical UI everywhere. Use when pixel parity across iOS, Android, web and desktop matters.

name: Expo
desc: Managed builds, OTA updates and native modules for React Native. Use unless you truly need a bare native project.

name: Ionic
desc: Web components in a native shell. Use when the app is mostly forms and lists and the team is web-only.

name: Capacitor
desc: Wraps any web app in a native container with plugin access. Use to ship an existing SPA to the app stores.

name: Kotlin Multiplatform
desc: Share business logic across iOS and Android while keeping native UI. Use when you want native feel but one domain layer.

name: SwiftUI
desc: Declarative native UI for Apple platforms. Use when the app must feel unmistakably iOS.

name: Jetpack Compose
desc: Declarative native UI for Android. Use for Android-first apps that need full platform access.

name: Electron
desc: Chromium plus Node in a desktop window. Use when you need full web compatibility and can afford a 100MB download.

name: Tauri
desc: Rust backend with the system webview, a few MB per binary. Use when Electron is too heavy.

name: .NET MAUI
desc: Cross-platform native apps from C#. Use in .NET shops that already own the business logic.

name: Fastlane
desc: Automates signing, screenshots and store uploads. Use the first time you upload a build by hand and hate it.

name: App Store Connect
desc: Apple review, TestFlight builds and phased release. Use whenever you ship to iOS, whether you like it or not.

name: Google Play Console
desc: Android release tracks, staged rollouts and vitals. Use for every Android release.
